bottleneck: The native proofs have not yet been accepted by actual AvalancheGo-hosted validators.
causal_hypothesis: The unchanged proof verifier and canonical transaction methods execute inside each real VM; identical public proof chunks yield five equal accepted roots and survive node restart.
single_intended_change: Replace the local-only canonical acceptance boundary with actual five-validator JSON-RPC submission, finalized receipt/root readback and restart recovery.
baseline: cocode-defmi-integration-003: smoke_only, primary1, two real native proofs, 740 in-process canonical blocks and completed upload recovery.
evaluation_population: One fresh isolated five-validator chain, the exact frozen native003 fill/no-fill proofs, all chunk uploads and declared canonical negatives, one validator restart. Same host is not independent operators.
likely_prediction_error: Actual VM authorization, large-state transport or consensus timings differ from the in-process driver and prevent finalization.
rejection_rule: Any missing real validator acceptance, differing roots, no restart readback, altered proof parameters, non-semantic error counted as rejection or existing deployment mutation blocks acceptance.
promotion_rule: At most smoke_only; no cryptographic security certification, independent operators, full application PQ migration or production promotion.
network_isolation: One new network-none container with loopback-only five-process validators, no published ports and no existing service state mounts.
